## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
GetParent:Int32 entity:Int32
```

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |

**Returns:** The handle of the parent of the entity, or 0 if it has none.
